content: For long toolpaths (thousands of points), rendering one Line2/LineSegments2 (or a single BufferGeometry-based Line) with all points as one draw call is dramatically faster than thousands of small mesh/line segments -- draw call count, not vertex count, is usually the bottleneck. Line2/LineSegments2 (fat lines with width, from three/examples/jsm/lines) support per-vertex color which is needed for move-type/depth-of-engagement color coding; forum reports show performance degrading once individual disconnected line objects reach ~1000+, so color-coded segments should be merged into one geometry with a vertex color attribute rather than one Object3D per segment.
